answer: A new identity spends its first 3 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 44% of full weight. Because the ledge weight is recomputed from the pigment history each close, the fable audit reveals the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 14 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
